what: Gold Fields mines gold in South Africa, Ghana, Australia, Peru and Chile. Australia provides the largest share of production, and the Salares Norte mine in Chile has recently started up.
moat: Long-life ore bodies in Australia and Ghana, with the Tarkwa and Damang operations and a joint venture with AngloGold in Ghana that cuts costs for both.
risks: South African, Ghanaian and Peruvian operations carry political and labour risk
Salares Norte start-up took longer than planned
Mining cost inflation has been persistent
opportunities: Revenue grew about 68% last year with a 41% net margin
Analysts see about 40% upside from current levels
watch: All-in sustaining cost per ounce and production from Salares Norte.
